title: The Amazing Digital Circus
synopsis: A human woman gets trapped in a surreal virtual reality circus alongside five other lost souls, now subject to the eccentric whims of an erratic AI ringmaster named Caine. High-speed, expressive English dialogue ideal for language acquisition.
creator: Glitch Productions / Gooseworx

title: Murder Drones
synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic frozen exoplanet, rogue worker drones fight for survival against lethal Murder Drones sent by their corporate creators. Fast-paced comedic action packed with colloquial American English dialogue.
creator: Glitch Productions / Liam Vickers

title: Helluva Boss
synopsis: Follow I.M.P, an immediate murder professional assassin company operating in the Underworld. Packed with theatrical songs, quick banter, and distinctive character voices for advanced native speech rhythm practice.
creator: SpindleHorse / Vivienne Medrano
